```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| 
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Base Google Cloud Storage Bucket
BUCKET_URL <- "https://storage.googleapis.com/ncrmp-atlantic-photos/MIR"

# 2. Load Local Plot CSV (Add 'data/plot_locations.csv' to your .gitignore!)
# Expected CSV columns: site, plot, year, lat, lon, filename

plot_data <- read.csv("gitignore/data/plot_locations.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!"in_bucket" %in% names(plot_data)) {
  plot_data$in_bucket <- TRUE
}

plot_data$marker_color <- ifelse(plot_data$in_bucket, "#10b981", "#9ca3af")

# 3. Spatial points
points_sf <- st_as_sf(plot_data, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Construct Popup HTML with an explicit JS trigger button
popups_html <- sprintf(
  "<b>Site: </b>%s<br>
   <b>Plot: </b>%s<br>
   <b>Year: </b>%s<br>
   <b>Status: </b>%s<br><br>
   <button onclick=\"loadGeoTiff('%s')\" style=\"background-color:#0284c7; color:white; border:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;\">
     📥 Load Photo Below
   </button>",
  plot_data$site,
  plot_data$plot,
  plot_data$year,
  ifelse(plot_data$in_bucket, "<span style='color:green;'>Available in GCS</span>", "<span style='color:gray;'>Not in Bucket</span>"),
  plot_data$filename
)

# 4. Regional Overview Map
main_map <- leaflet(elementId = "main_map", width = "100%", height = "550px") %>%
  setView(lng = -81.00, lat = 24.70, zoom = 9) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addTiles(group = "OpenStreetMap") %>%
  
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = points_sf,
    radius = 12,
    color = "#ffffff",
    fillColor = ~marker_color,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    weight = 2,
    layerId = plot_data$filename,
    popup = popups_html
  ) %>%
  
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = c("#10b981", "#9ca3af"),
    labels = c("File in Bucket", "File Missing/Pending"),
    title = "Bucket Status",
    opacity = 0.9
  ) %>%
  
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Satellite", "OpenStreetMap"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

# 5. Include geotiff.js
geotiff_library <- tags$script(src = "[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/geotiff](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/geotiff)")

# 6. Global JS Function invoked directly by button or marker
js_script <- tags$script(HTML("
  window.loadGeoTiff = function(filename) {
    if (!filename) return;
    
    let bucketUrl = '[https://storage.googleapis.com/ncrmp-atlantic-photos/MIR/](https://storage.googleapis.com/ncrmp-atlantic-photos/MIR/)';
    let fullImageUrl = bucketUrl + filename;
    
    let statusEl = document.getElementById('photo_status');
    let progressContainer = document.getElementById('progress_container');
    let progressBar = document.getElementById('progress_bar');
    let progressText = document.getElementById('progress_text');
    let canvas = document.getElementById('tiff_canvas');
    let ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    // Reveal Progress Bar UI immediately
    progressContainer.style.display = 'block';
    progressBar.style.width = '0%';
    progressText.innerText = '0%';
    statusEl.innerHTML = '⚡ Fetching GeoTIFF: <b>' + filename + '</b>...';
    
    // Clear previous drawing
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    
    // Stream array buffer via XHR
    let xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('GET', fullImageUrl, true);
    xhr.responseType = 'arraybuffer';
    
    xhr.onprogress = function(event) {
      if (event.lengthComputable) {
        let percentComplete = Math.round((event.loaded / event.total) * 100);
        progressBar.style.width = percentComplete + '%';
        progressText.innerText = percentComplete + '%';
        
        if (percentComplete === 100) {
          statusEl.innerHTML = '⚙️ Processing pixel arrays for <b>' + filename + '</b>...';
        }
      } else {
        statusEl.innerHTML = '⚡ Downloading GeoTIFF...';
      }
    };
    
    xhr.onload = async function() {
      if (xhr.status === 200) {
        try {
          let arrayBuffer = xhr.response;
          const tiff = await GeoTIFF.fromArrayBuffer(arrayBuffer);
          const image = await tiff.getImage();
          const width = image.getWidth();
          const height = image.getHeight();
          
          const rasters = await image.readRasters();
          
          canvas.width = width;
          canvas.height = height;
          
          const imgData = ctx.createImageData(width, height);
          const data = imgData.data;
          
          for (let i = 0; i < rasters[0].length; i++) {
            let val = rasters[0][i];
            let idx = i * 4;
            data[idx]     = rasters[0][i];
            data[idx + 1] = rasters[1] ? rasters[1][i] : val;
            data[idx + 2] = rasters[2] ? rasters[2][i] : val;
            data[idx + 3] = 255;
          }
          
          ctx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
          statusEl.innerHTML = '✅ Active Photo: <b>' + filename + '</b>';
          
          setTimeout(() => { progressContainer.style.display = 'none'; }, 1000);
          
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(err);
          statusEl.innerHTML = '<span style=\"color:red;\">Error parsing TIFF pixel buffer.</span>';
        }
      } else {
        statusEl.innerHTML = '<span style=\"color:red;\">HTTP Error ' + xhr.status + ': File missing or CORS restricted on GCS.</span>';
      }
    };
    
    xhr.onerror = function() {
      statusEl.innerHTML = '<span style=\"color:red;\">Network error or CORS restriction on Google Cloud Storage.</span>';
    };
    
    xhr.send();
  };
  
  // Also catch direct marker clicks if popup is closed
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    let checkMap = setInterval(function() {
      let mainMapWidget = HTMLWidgets.find('#main_map');
      if (!mainMapWidget) return;
      clearInterval(checkMap);
      let map = mainMapWidget.getMap();
      map.on('layerclick', function(e) {
        if (e.layer && e.layer.options && e.layer.options.layerId) {
          window.loadGeoTiff(e.layer.options.layerId);
        }
      });
    }, 400);
  });
"))

# 7. Render Page Layout
div(
  geotiff_library,
  tags$h3("1. Regional Overview Map"),
  tags$p(tags$small("Click any green marker, then click 'Load Photo Below' inside the popup.")),
  main_map,
  tags$hr(),
  tags$h3("2. Site Photo Preview"),
  
  # Status Text & Progress Bar
  tags$p(id = "photo_status", style = "font-weight: bold; color: #0284c7;", "Select a marker above to display the photo."),
  div(
    id = "progress_container",
    style = "display: none; margin-bottom: 15px;",
    div(
      style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;",
      div(
        style = "flex-grow: 1; background-color: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 9999px; height: 14px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;",
        div(id = "progress_bar", style = "width: 0%; height: 100%; background-color: #0284c7; transition: width 0.15s ease;")
      ),
      span(id = "progress_text", style = "font-size: 0.9em; font-weight: bold; color: #0284c7; min-width: 40px;", "0%")
    )
  ),
  
  # Canvas Area
  div(
    style = "min-height: 200px; padding: 10px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; overflow-x: auto;",
    tags$canvas(id = "tiff_canvas", style = "max-width: 100%; height: auto; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px;")
  ),
  js_script
)
```
